summary: Iter16 sprint bundle (F-A audit attachments, F-B auto-scroll, F-C pending Accept flow) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS: (F-C1) POST /api/chat/session/anonymous with admin online returns status='pending' + pending_agent_id=admin.id + pending_expires_at ~30s; POST /api/chat/sessions/{id}/accept flips it to status='open' with assigned_agent_id set and pending_* unset. (F-C2) Force-expired pending_expires_at + wait 7s → pending_scheduler_loop tick populates pending_declined_by with the original agent and, with only one online agent, moves session to status='queued' with queue_position + cleared pending fields. (F-C3) Wrong agent POST /accept returns 403 'This chat was offered to another agent'; correct pending_agent_id returns 200 open. (F-A1) DELETE /api/chat/messages/{id} on a message that had an attachment stamps original_attachments (id+filename preserved), deleted=true, deleted_by_name; customer GET /api/chat/public/{sid}/messages does NOT include the deleted message. (F-A2) PATCH /api/chat/messages/{id} adding an attachment as agent role: agent response strips previous_versions/original_content/original_attachments (edited=true kept); admin /api/admin/audit/edits returns previous_versions[0].attachments===[], attachments===[{new-att-1}], original_attachments===[]; customer public GET returns final attachments only with no 'edited' flag. Frontend (Playwright, admin logged into /dashboard): [data-testid='pending-offers'] container renders with 4 incoming offers, each PendingOfferCard shows customer name 'Guest' + live 'Auto-reassign in Ns' countdown + Accept button. Clicking accept-offer-<sid> removes the card from pending-offers and inserts session-item-<sid> into the active list (backend GET confirms status='open', assigned_agent_id=admin.id). /admin → tab-audit renders 13 audit-item cards, 2 with Paperclip/attachment renderings (F-A UI). Widget loads cleanly on / (Lily greeting visible, launcher works). No pageerrors and no console errors during the flow (only expected WS reconnect warning while token was refreshed).
critical_code_review_comments: AgentDashboard.jsx (1125 lines) and ChatWidget.jsx still exceed the 700-line guideline; splitting PendingOfferCard, chime hook, and session list into modules would help.
chat.py::edit_message still uses manager._safe_send (private). Same call site was flagged in iter15 — consider promoting to a public WSManager API.

Both /api/chat/session and /api/chat/session/anonymous duplicate the 'if status==pending → send_to_agents(pending_offer) + auto_busy check' block. Extract a helper (e.g. services.notify_pending(session_doc)) to keep DRY.

expire_pending_offers() has a subtle race: pending_declined_by is updated before offer_session_to_agent, but the reassignment doc write occurs in a separate update; two concurrent scheduler ticks (only one runs today, but if scaled) could double-offer. Consider $findOneAndUpdate with status pre-condition.
Admin audit endpoint returns rows sorted by edited_at, but deleted-only messages may have no edited_at set — those may sort last. Consider $ifNull to fall back to deleted_at/created_at.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (pending-offers UI + accept flow + audit tab attachment rendering)

seed_data_creation: Multiple anon sessions created per run with client_id prefixes iter16_/iter16_ui_. One deleted message + one edited message with attachment change persist in messages/audit collection. Agent is toggled online/offline during tests — final state may leave agent offline; main agent should reset if needed for interactive testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The agent user (agent@livechat.com) is set OFFLINE during iter16 tests so admin becomes the sole online agent and receives pending offers deterministically. If a future test needs both agents online, explicitly bring both online. To exercise the pending timeout without waiting 30s, monkey-patch pending_expires_at directly in mongo (db.sessions.updateOne({id:sid},{$set:{pending_expires_at:'2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'}})) then sleep >=6s for the pending_scheduler_loop 5s tick. Route for the agent workspace is /dashboard (not /agent). Admins can access /dashboard directly. Pending offers accumulated in prior runs may remain visible until reassigned or accepted — feel free to db.sessions.deleteMany({status:{$in:['pending','queued']}}) before your run.
